header.title: Curse tablets from Roma (Epigraphic Database Heidelberg): AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Greek curse tablets
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:defix:edh:roma:grc, from the Epigraphic Database Heidelberg (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY-SA 4.0, as its source requires: credit the Epigraphic Database Heidelberg and this AI translation, and share adaptations under the same licence.

notes.42054.8: Capitalised words are magical names, kept as they stand. Line 6 holds two names that look like Latin names in Greek letters (Leikeitiōsous, Loukounti[l]os); they could not be identified.
